title: Lilavati's First Question
devanagari: अये बाले लीलावति मतिमति ब्रूहि सहितान्
translation: O young Lilavati, clever girl! Tell me the sum of 2, 5, 32, 193, 18 and 10, with 100 added to them. And tell me also what is left when this sum is taken away from ten thousand, if you are skilled in the methods of addition and subtraction in arithmetic.
translation_hi: हे बाला लीलावती, हे बुद्धिमती! 2, 5, 32, 193, 18 और 10 में 100 जोड़कर इनका योग बताओ। और यदि तुम अंकगणित में जोड़ और घटाव की विधि में कुशल हो, तो यह भी बताओ कि दस हज़ार में से यह योग घटाने पर कितना बचता है।

words.meaning: in the method of addition and subtraction

question: What is the sum of all the numbers (including the 100)?
solution:
2 + 5 + 32 + 193 + 18 + 10 + 100 = 360

Taken away from an ayuta: 10,000 − 360 = 9,640

Science link: right before this verse, Bhaskara lists names for every power of ten up to 1017: एक, दश, शत, सहस्र, अयुत, लक्ष, प्रयुत, कोटि… ending with परार्ध. This is the decimal place-value system that India gave the world, the same one every computer still prints numbers in.
